description:
Pydantic configuration model for MethylCentroid parameters.

Workflows:
- Initial centroid creation: provide add_samples, output_dir for saving
- Centroid updates: provide add_samples/remove_samples; current cohort is derived from
  existing centroid HDF5 metadata (samples_used) when applicable (see MethylCentroid).

add_samples.description: Optional list of new sample paths to add incrementally
add_samples.title: Add Samples

binned_stats_bins.description: Number of bins for the required per-position ECDF histogram. Must be >= 1. Default 20.
binned_stats_bins.title: Binned Stats Bins

cap_coverage.description: If True, cap per-CpG coverage on each sample with binomial thinning before adding to centroid
cap_coverage.title: Cap Coverage

cap_coverage_auto_n_cap.description: If True and cap_coverage_n_cap is None, estimate n_cap from first sample using Q3+1.5*IQR on sampled positions (outlier limit)
cap_coverage_auto_n_cap.title: Cap Coverage Auto N Cap

cap_coverage_n_cap.description: Max coverage per position; positions with coverage > this are thinned (requires cap_coverage=True)
cap_coverage_n_cap.title: Cap Coverage N Cap

cap_coverage_n_cap_iqr_multiplier.description: IQR multiplier for auto n_cap when method=iqr (standard boxplot fence=1.5)
cap_coverage_n_cap_iqr_multiplier.title: Cap Coverage N Cap Iqr Multiplier

cap_coverage_n_cap_max_positions.description: Max positions to sample when auto-estimating n_cap (keeps estimation fast)
cap_coverage_n_cap_max_positions.title: Cap Coverage N Cap Max Positions

gpu_backend.description: Numeric array backend: numpy, cupy (NVIDIA CUDA), or mojo (mojo-align numeric DeviceContext). Unset keeps CuPy-or-NumPy auto. Operator-set per profile/site; do not encode a package default.
gpu_backend.title: Gpu Backend

max_sample_workers.description: Maximum parallel workers for sample loading
max_sample_workers.title: Max Sample Workers

min_coverage.description: Minimum sum of mC and uC for a position
min_coverage.title: Min Coverage

remove_samples.description: Optional list of sample paths to remove
remove_samples.title: Remove Samples

residualize_coef_dir.description: Optional coefficient directory from pipeline.residualize_fit. When unset, centroid uses raw betas (shipped-pack path).
residualize_coef_dir.title: Residualize Coef Dir

use_gpu.description: Prefer an accelerator when the selected gpu_backend can use one. Operator-set per profile/site.
use_gpu.title: Use Gpu

title: MethylCentroidConfig
